The system generated this warning because it detected a high risk (61%) that your vehicle's battery voltage will drop to a low level within the next 3 to 15 hours.

The analysis looked at your vehicle's data from the last 24 hours to find out why this might happen. It found that battery voltage is strongly linked to how much current is flowing and the battery's temperature—when current or temperature goes up, voltage tends to go down. However, the statistics could not determine which way these factors cause the changes; they just move together. Because no specific cause was identified with confidence, the system is flagging this as "Investigating" so you can check the battery health and charging system.
is the target nide also affecting some other node?

No, this analysis did not find any evidence that the low battery voltage is affecting other parts of the vehicle. The "Downstream Nodes" section is empty, meaning the statistics didn't show any other metrics (like vibration or temperature) being negatively impacted by the voltage drop in this specific vehicle's history.
